market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is trading around $77,600-78,600 on Apr 27-28, 2026. To dip to $45,000 by Dec 31, 2026 requires a ~42% drawdown in 8 months. While Bitcoin has historically had >40% drawdowns within bear cycles, current consolidation above key support and post-halving dynamics make such a deep crash unlikely absent a major macro shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Probability of a black-swan macro/regulatory event causing a deep crash
